name: @image-host/test
//: A workspace project so `pnpm -r typecheck` and `pnpm run lint` reach this directory, and so pnpm links the bare specifiers its files import — pnpm's layout is strict, so an unhooked `test/` cannot resolve `hono` at all. The tsconfig maps the workspace path aliases; only bare specifiers are listed here, and each is pinned to the same range a sibling package declares so the store holds one copy.

scripts.//typecheck: The 4 GB floor is a measurement, not a precaution. Under pnpm's default heap this project is killed by V8 while checking files that import most of the workspace, and tsc emits no `error TS` line when it dies — so the failure is indistinguishable from a clean run to anything grepping the output.
